description: This file defines the TypeScript interface 'PatchedOpenDataConversion' and functions for JSON serialization/deserialization related to this interface, including external references to other data models like OpenDataUnit, OpenDataFood, and OpenDataVersion.

classes.name: PatchedOpenDataConversion
classes.description: Interface representing a data structure for open data conversion with nested properties and optional fields.

methods.name: instanceOfPatchedOpenDataConversion
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the PatchedOpenDataConversion interface.

methods.name: PatchedOpenDataConversionFromJSON
methods.description: Function to parse JSON into a PatchedOpenDataConversion object.

methods.name: PatchedOpenDataConversionFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Typed version of the JSON parsing function with discriminator handling.

methods.name: PatchedOpenDataConversionToJSON
methods.description: Function to serialize a PatchedOpenDataConversion object into JSON.
